On day 9 of therapy, he reported loss of appetite and malaise, followed by generalized pruritus, dark urine, and jaundice.
He was started on oral Alfuzosin 10 mg once daily.

Laboratory studies showed leukocyte count 5.8 K/μL, AST 175 U/L (0–40), ALT 402 U/L (0–55), alkaline phosphatase 235 U/L (15–250), γ-glutamyl transferase 327 U/L (8–61), total bilirubin 7.6 mg/dL (0.2–1.2), and direct bilirubin 5.8 mg/dL (0–0.25)
